code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), leukopenia with neutropenia and lymphopenia, mild thrombocytopenia, elevated INR, and high ferritin, with increased monocytes and basophils. There is also low serum protein and mild hypoglycemia. These findings suggest acute severe systemic illness, possibly sepsis or severe inflammatory response, with impaired oxygenation and hematologic involvement. Immediate clinical evaluation is recommended.
